title: Where the data lives and what crosses between places
description: Every place Hewn's data can be, and every flow between them, each classed by what it exposes. The written companion is docs/security/DATA_FLOW.md.

private.label: Private
private.description: Plaintext about a person or a business. Never leaves the device, never on a server.

sealed.label: Sealed
sealed.description: Ciphertext that may travel: a backup, a letter, a record. Opened only with a key the person holds.

public.label: Public
public.description: Hashes, commitments, block heights, code, two counts a country. Public on purpose; nothing about a person.

control.label: Control
control.description: Not data: a request to sign, a deploy, a fee. Shown or logged where it happens.

regions.name: The person
regions.description: What only the person holds: the passphrase, the recovery key, a backup they saved.

regions.name: The device
regions.description: The browser that holds the books: the encrypted vault, the books open in memory for one session, the app's code.

regions.name: Shield
regions.description: The wallet app on the phone. It holds the account's keys, signs every transaction and shows what is being signed.

regions.name: Aleo
regions.description: The network: private records only their owner can open, and public mappings that hold hashes, commitments and heights.

regions.name: Explorer API
regions.description: Provable's public read API: mappings and transaction status. The only chain reads the app makes.

regions.name: Vercel
regions.description: Serves the app's code. One API route, for the traction counts. Sees requests like any host; holds no data.

regions.name: Upstash
regions.description: Two counts per country since launch: visits and visitors. Nothing else.

regions.name: GitHub
regions.description: The source, the CI gate, this map, and the one secret that deploys programs (in the chain repository).

regions.name: Observers
regions.description: Who sees what regardless of Hewn: anyone reading public state, and the stablecoin issuer's compliance record.

nodes.label: Username + passphrase
nodes.holds: Typed at login, held in memory only. Never stored, never sent, never verified anywhere.

nodes.label: Recovery key
nodes.holds: Shown once when made, kept by the person. The only way back from a lost passphrase.

nodes.label: Backup file
nodes.holds: The vault's ciphertext as a file, saved through the phone's share sheet or a download. Useless without the username and passphrase.

nodes.label: View key (a business)
nodes.holds: Typed once in setup or Settings so the books can read the business's incoming private payments. Kept only inside the encrypted books; never sent, logged or shown back.

nodes.label: The app, in this tab
nodes.holds: The ledger, payroll, sales and reports, running in the page. Code only; it carries no data of its own.

nodes.label: The books (open)
nodes.holds: The plaintext books: entries, team, wages, invoices. In memory for this session only.

nodes.label: Data key
nodes.holds: A random AES-256-GCM key, non-extractable, that encrypts the books. Wrapped by the unlock secret; never stored in plaintext, except while Stay logged in keeps it.

nodes.label: The vault (IndexedDB)
nodes.holds: The books as ciphertext. The one durable store on the device.

nodes.label: Stay logged in
nodes.holds: Only when the person ticks it: the open data key, non-extractable, in the browser's storage for at most 24 hours by this device's clock. Forgotten on Log out. While kept, anyone with the device or a copy of its browser profile can open the books.

nodes.label: Web storage flags
nodes.holds: Five flags and nothing else: an account exists here, this device was counted, the step a load stuck at. Never a name, a number or an id.

nodes.label: Chain code
nodes.holds: The part of the app that talks to Shield and the explorer. Loads only on the pages that need it.

nodes.label: The one door to Shield
nodes.holds: The single module that touches the wallet adapter. Nothing else in the app can send a transaction.

nodes.label: Shield wallet
nodes.holds: The account's private key and view key, in Shield. Every transaction is signed here, with what it does shown first.

nodes.label: Records Shield opens
nodes.holds: The account's private records (letters, backups, USDCx), decrypted by Shield with its view key and handed to the page on request.

nodes.label: Fee service (testnet)
nodes.holds: On testnet Shield pays the network fee, publicly. A private fee fails there (the backup note in Settings).

nodes.label: Private records
nodes.holds: Letters (paystubs, invoices, messages), backups of the books, agreements, credentials, USDCx. Only the owner can open them.

nodes.label: Public mappings
nodes.holds: Name hashes, commitments, statuses, block heights, anchored period roots. Never an amount, a name or a memo; never a running total.

nodes.label: The programs
nodes.holds: Deployed and immutable. A change is a new version with a migration note.

nodes.label: Explorer API
nodes.holds: Mapping reads and transaction status, public data. It can see which names and addresses a page looks up.

nodes.label: The app's code
nodes.holds: The website build, served with one security policy for the whole app. No database, no API that sees plaintext.

nodes.label: Traction route
nodes.holds: The one server function. It receives a country and a yes/no and adds to two counts. No date, address or id.

nodes.label: Two counts a country
nodes.holds: Visits and visitors per country since launch. The only data Hewn keeps on any server, and the only exception to INV-02.

nodes.label: The source
nodes.holds: AGPL-3.0. Every change is one pull request, merged after Joshua approves it in session.

nodes.label: The CI gate
nodes.holds: Tests, the rule checks, the build, the dependency audit, on every pull request. Read-only, no secrets.

nodes.label: This map
nodes.holds: Built from the tree on every push to main and published on GitHub Pages.

nodes.label: The admin key
nodes.holds: The key that deploys and upgrades the programs, only in the chain repository's environment secret, read by manual workflows that print a redacted form.

nodes.label: Anyone reading the chain
nodes.holds: Sees every public mapping and the shape of every transaction: which program, when, the fee. Not who, not how much.

nodes.label: The stablecoin issuer
nodes.holds: Receives a compliance record of every private USDCx transfer, by the token's own design. The one party outside the two accounts that sees a payment.
